summary_en: The study tests PRT12396, an investigational drug, in people with polycythemia vera or myelofibrosis, which are types of myeloproliferative neoplasms. It is given as a capsule by mouth twice a day, swallowed whole with water, and may be taken one hour before or two hours after meals; how long treatment lasts is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug, and early signs of effect, and it aims to find the maximum tolerated dose; it is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa PRT12396, un medicamento en investigación, en personas con policitemia vera o mielofibrosis, que son tipos de neoplasias mieloproliferativas. Se administra en cápsulas por vía oral dos veces al día, tragadas enteras con agua, y puede tomarse una hora antes o dos horas después de las comidas; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el cuerpo procesa el medicamento y las primeras señales de efecto, y busca encontrar la dosis máxima tolerada; es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with polycythemia vera or myelofibrosis confirmed by WHO 2016 or ICC/WHO 2022 criteria
Estimated life expectancy of at least 12 weeks per investigator
Adequate blood count, kidney and liver function, and bone marrow reserve
not_for: Another malignancy within the past 3 years, unless considered cured with low risk of recurrence
Prior systemic therapy for PV or MF, or prior or planned allogeneic stem-cell transplant
Use of strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers, or acid-reducing agents that cannot be stopped
Participation in another interventional clinical study
